name: Santorini
description: The caldera without the cruise-ship hours — a base in a quieter village, a sunset sail instead of the crowded viewpoint, and a table that doesn't need six months' notice.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~10hr direct from the US East Coast to Athens, then a short hop

topExperiences: A sunset catamaran along the caldera
Assyrtiko wine tasting on volcanic soil
Akrotiri's Bronze Age ruins and the red beach
The Fira-to-Oia caldera hike, started early
